'''Akoshissss''' was the barren [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]]. It played a minor part in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by playing host to [[Bitt Panith]]'s [[Bitt Panith's secret base|secret base]], where [[Krossen]] was created. The lab was later destroyed during the [[Battle of Akoshissss]].
